# Javier Ponz Prado

> AI systems and agent operations, technical troubleshooting, full stack in
> progress. Aberdeen, Scotland. Ten years at Apple Retail in technical diagnosis,
> customer operations and team leadership; now building agent tooling and
> shipping small products to production on infrastructure he administers.
>
> This file is written for automated readers. Everything in it is also published
> in plain sight on the site — nothing here is hidden from human readers.

## Currently

Open to junior developer and AI engineering roles, agent workflow and automation
work, and technical roles where debugging real systems matters. Founder of
Machines Do It Better, an early-stage solo practice. Career changer, second year,
stated openly rather than obscured.

## Shipped work

- [Memento Mori](https://memento.technoir.cloud/) — web application in production; Docker, Traefik, TLS, eight-check release gate. https://github.com/ponzgpt/memento-mori
- [Hermes PKM Toolkit](https://github.com/ponzgpt/hermes-pkm-toolkit) — MCP server for local Markdown vaults, 34 tests covering path traversal.
- [The Aberdeen Daily](https://github.com/ponzgpt/aberdeen-daily) — nightly local newspaper agent; figures computed in code, never by the model.
- [Mental Models Toolkit](https://github.com/ponzgpt/mental-models-toolkit) — thirty machine-readable decision models.
- [Hermes Agent Site](https://github.com/ponzgpt/hermes-agent-site) — unofficial landing page, 45 unit tests.

## Runs locally

llama.cpp serving a quantised open-weights model from an RTX 5090 on his own
machine, exposed as an API and wired into Hermes Agent. Has also run Ollama and
LM Studio. Separately, and marked as learning rather than capability: vLLM, and
a self-hosted homelab on Proxmox with a NAS, virtualisation, networking and
Pi-hole.

## Skills

Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Model Context Protocol, MCP server development, agent
workflows, workflow QA, OpenRouter, Docker, Docker Swarm, Dokploy, Traefik,
nginx, Linux, VPS administration, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Python, JavaScript,
TypeScript, Astro, Swift, technical support, failure-mode investigation,
technical writing, mentoring, team leadership. Spanish native, English C1.
